```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Republicans believe economic self-sufficiency is the ultimate answer to the challenges confronting Indian country.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Tribal governments and their communities, not Washington bureaucracies, are best situated to craft solutions that will end systemic problems that create poverty and disenfranchisement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The federal government should not stifle the development of resources within the reservations, which need federal assistance to advance their commerce nationally through roads and technology.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Federal and state regulations that thwart job creation must be withdrawn or redrawn so that tribal governments acting on behalf of American Indians are not disadvantaged.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party has persistently undermined tribal sovereignty in order to provide advantage to union bosses in the tribal workplace.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Native communities should have the same authority as state governments in labor matters, so that union bosses and the National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) cannot undermine the authority of tribal governments.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
